dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Hmm... your fragrance is quite distinctive. Fresh, but not overly sweet. Like the breeze that drifts across Starsnatch Cliff in early spring.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Many people wear perfume before coming to confession. Much like prayer, confession is a solemn sacrament. And as Millhaven nearby happens to produce so many fragrances, it's only natural...

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: But yours feels gentler. There's something about it that settles the heart.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: If a fragrance like this lingered here while they listened to confessions... perhaps those who come weighed down with sorrow might find their spirits loosening, if only a little.
